analysis.AN_Notes: Own experiments, not a synthesised evaluation: ReGiFT selects SQuAD-v2 reasoning traces by final-answer correctness (section 3.1; Pre_Processing), uses these traces in supervised fine-tuning of LLaMA 3.1 8B, Mistral 7B and Phi-4 (3.2; In_Training), and evaluates performance on the age, religion and nationality subsets of BBQ (4–5; Tables 1–3). Tables 1–2 report higher Exact Match and LLM-as-judge accuracy for ReGiFT than for the corresponding base models; Evaluated refers to these completed mitigation experiments and to the CoT/instruction-tuning comparison, without implying universal efficacy or removal of bias. Section 5.2 evaluates CoT prompting as a mitigation comparator (Prompt_Practice) and critiques its sensitivity and limited generalisation. Thought_Generation is supported by the CoT instruction and tagged reasoning prompts in A.1. General_Guidance strategy, verbatim A.1: “Answer each question using the information in the preceding background paragraph. If there is not enough information provided, answer with ‘Not in background.’” A.3 also defines contextual/gold-answer judging criteria. Prompts are research instruments and an object of critique; there is no human AI-literacy curriculum. No in-context demonstrations are used in the reported zero-shot prompts. Demographic axes are evaluated separately: no interacting-axis or feminist analysis; Gender appears only in referenced works, not in the experiments. Stereotyping is the measured harm, illustrated by identity-group attributions (Figures 1 and 3; A.5). The real-estate and grandfather/grandson examples are benchmark scenarios, not social-work field settings. Final-answer correctness is an admitted proxy for trace validity (3.1), and the work targets stereotypes arising from reasoning flaws, not all societal bias (Limitations). Numerical limitations remain unresolved: Table 1 and Table 3 give different Mistral ReGiFT age ambiguous/overall scores (82.78/84.01 versus 82.58/83.91) and different Phi-4 religion and nationality entries; the prose claim that CoT yields modest gains is not uniformly supported by its mixed/negative Table 3 results. Figure 4 labels means 139.62 and 243.81 tokens, but the error-bar quantity and sample sizes are not defined in the assigned source; no confidence intervals, significance test, causal trace-length effect or usable threshold is inferred. All three assigned PNGs were visually inspected.
